messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "take on empty stomach at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast"
set: ["take on empty stomach at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast", "at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast", "take on an empty stomach", "take at least 30 minutes after aspirin", "take oral suspension on an empty stomach", "administer 15 minutes before eating breakfast", "exercising at least 30 minutes most days", "take 30 minutes after dinner", "take liquid medicine on an empty stomach at least 1 hour before a meal or 2 hours after a meal", "take at least 8 hours before aspirin", "take at least 4 hours before resin", "15 to 30 minutes", "taken at least 30 minutes before first food beverage or other oral medications of the day", "take other medications at least 2 hours before or after", "requirement applies after at least 30 days on 7 mg dose", "dose taken 30 minutes before start of single-day HEC"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
